title: a.out (assembler output) signature
summary: a.out is the original Unix executable format. Magic number: 0x0107 (OMAGIC, text+data, writable text), 0x0108 (NMAGIC, text read-only, shared text), 0x010B (ZMAGIC, demand-paged, text read-only), 0x010D (QMAGIC, 32-bit, page-aligned).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: a.out is the original Unix executable format (pre-ELF).
a.out has been replaced by ELF on all modern Unix systems.
a.out lacks dynamic linking support (static linking only).
